main_text.p: suum contra me evomant. Ipsi viderint, & norint Deum resi-stere superbis, humilibus autem gratiam dare. Cæterum præfixi de hac dissertatione judicium maximi & sincerissimi Theologi D. Andreæ Riveti, cujus candidum, sanum, defæcatum-que animum, incorruptum judi-dium, summam doctrinum, prudentiam, & merita tota Ecclesia novit & ipsi adversa-rii suspiciunt; cujus etiam ve-stigia, ut & D. Walæi, p. m. accuratè expressi in hac materia, prout unicuivis legenti patebit. Addidi & Epistolium Clariss-simi

page.notes: The word "novit" after "Ecclesia" is struck through by a line in the print. The strike may be printed or may be a mark on the scan; it is transcribed here as printed. Diagonal pen-like marks run through "sincerissimi" and "sanum" and across "Andreæ"; these are marks on the scan, not print, and are left out. The last line reads "Claris-" with the following "simi" at the right; the word is completed as "Clariss-simi" with the hyphen as printed. The word "unicuivis" is read as printed. Stains and the "Digitized by Google" stamp are left out.
